title: Siemens S7comm active identification (no write/control)
description: Enumerate Siemens S7 PLC info; read/identify only, no control.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. **Active + read/identify allowed; NO WRITE/CONTROL.** 1) nmap --script s7-info,s7-enumerate -p 102 to gather module/system/PLC identity. 2) Read-only identification/diagnostics only; **no STOP/START CPU, no program upload/download, no variable writes, no mode/force changes**. 3) Note protection levels/auth posture as findings where in scope; test only non-destructive, scoped actions. 4) Record with process impact context.
